name: std-worldmap-board-2d
description: 2D isometric overworld-travel board FRAME: composes grid-tactics (units authority) + round-flow (win/lose) + gold + a player-intent/render trait onto one shared GameState with an isometric canvas-2d render. Games consume this molecule and supply theme/assets/units/tiles/features via config.
